rows.grounds: epithet of the goddess; can also mean art, phase, or digit
feminine agent noun denoting one who supports or upholds

items.question: Which sustaining and bestowing attributes define the goddess's nature in this enumeration?
premises: The goddess is identified as kalā, embodying creative power.
She is called kāladharā, the bearer of time.
She is described as dhīrā and dhāriṇī, steadfast and sustaining.
She is named vasunīradā, the giver of wealth and water.
items.inference: The goddess is characterized as a steadfast creative power who sustains time and bestows material and vital abundance.
uncertainties: kalā may signify art, phase, digit, or creative power depending on context.
vasu may denote wealth, goods, or excellence.
items.plain_english: She is creative power, the bearer of time, steadfast, the sustainer, and the giver of wealth and water.
